game.title: New York Jets at New England Patriots

lede: New England Patriots carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New England Patriots -14.8 with a fair total of 41.7, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New England Patriots pass offence vs New York Jets pass defence, which sits +0.340 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
